bio: Peak Radiant in Valiant Protocol and Level 10 Face-It in Global Strike. If your crosshair placement is at knee level, swipe left. Looking for a real duo partner.

nodes.partnerMessage: Alright {PlayerName}, tell me your main game or I'm unmatching in 30 seconds. Timer starts now.

choices.choiceText: Tactical shooters. Valiant Protocol and Global Strike all night.
Cozy sandbox games. I build dirt huts and harvest wheat in MineBlock.
Competitive games are a waste of life. Grow up.
Timer? Relax, we aren't in overtime on map three of a grand final.

nodes.partnerMessage: Oh, an actual human of culture! Don't break my heart: are you a Phantom or Vandal person in Valiant, and do you know default smoke lineups?

choices.choiceText: Vandal. Clean one-taps only. First bullet accuracy or nothing.
Phantom. Better spray transfer through smokes, zero bullet tracers.
I only buy the heavy sniper rifle and hold garage from spawn.
Lineups? I just run onto site, panic, and spray at the ceiling.

nodes.partnerMessage: A dirt hut?! A literal green-top mud cube in 2026?! Unacceptable. I need to coach your macro skills before I get secondhand tilt.

choices.choiceText: Dirt huts are peak resource efficiency! Zero stone wasted.
Then coach me, sensei. My keyboard is ready for your orders.
You sound like someone whose bedroom smells like stale sour energy drinks.

nodes.partnerMessage: Oh wow, an enlightened philosopher on a dating app! Tell me, does looking down on people's hobbies cure your loneliness, or do you always introduce yourself with a red card?

choices.choiceText: Just wanted to see if your brain functions outside of 120 FPS pixels.
My bad. That was an awful opening line. Can we please restart?

nodes.partnerMessage: Overtime is where legends are forged and frauds get exposed! My heart rate during 14-14 overtime is my cardio for the day.

choices.choiceText: That explains the intense energy. What agent role do you main?
You need actual outdoor cardio, girl. Touch grass.

nodes.partnerMessage: A purist! Respect. Nothing fuels my dopamine receptors like that sweet, crisp 'dink' headshot sound when you catch an enemy peeking mid.

choices.choiceText: Especially when it's against toxic duelists talking trash in all-chat.
What rank are you rocking right now? Be honest with me.
I bet you whiff 90% of your shots and blame hit registration.

nodes.partnerMessage: YES! Finally someone who understands spray control! Everyone hypes the 160 damage headshot until they spam through smoke and get traced down!

choices.choiceText: Brain over aim every time. Utility and positioning win championships.
You sound like someone who reads balance patch notes as bedtime stories.
Phantom users just can't click heads. It's a crutch for bad aim.

nodes.partnerMessage: A sniper crutch?! Oh no. If you miss your first flick, are you that guy who immediately pulls out a secondary and starts jumping around in panic?

choices.choiceText: I never miss. But if I do, my secondary pistol tracking is lethal.
I panic-jump and pray to the gaming gods. Don't expose my secrets!

nodes.partnerMessage: Run and spray?! What is this, a plastic-rank deathmatch lobby?! Get your crosshair disciplined or stay far away from my competitive lobbies!

choices.choiceText: Teach me your discipline then. I genuinely want to learn from you.
It's just a game, stop acting like you're an Olympic athlete.

nodes.partnerMessage: Resource efficiency?! There's literally an Enderman staring into your ceiling right now having an existential crisis on your behalf!

choices.choiceText: Come into my server and build me a real fortress then.
I bet your base is just an over-engineered redstone monstrosity.

nodes.partnerMessage: My coaching fees are steep, {PlayerName}. One large iced peach green tea, zero backseat gaming, and you dry-peek corners only when I call flashes.

choices.choiceText: Iced peach green tea is already ordered. What's drill number one?
What if I end up carrying you on the scoreboard instead?
I don't take orders from girls who spend 14 hours inside.

nodes.partnerMessage: My setup smells like lavender room spray and clean keycaps, you barbarian. My keyboard alone costs more than your monthly grocery bill.

choices.choiceText: Spending $400 on plastic clickers isn't a personality trait.
Wait... you're a custom mechanical keyboard nerd too?

nodes.partnerMessage: My brain functions fast enough to track 120 FPS target transitions, which is clearly too high of a refresh rate for your boring conversation.

choices.choiceText: Keep clicking circles in your dark cave, loser.
Okay, that was actually a witty comeback. Respect.

nodes.partnerMessage: Mmh. Surprised you walked that back. Most guys on here just double down on 'make me a sandwich' jokes the second they see my match history.

choices.choiceText: I hate that misogynistic trash. You're an athlete, simple as that.
Do guys really get that insecure when you outfrag them?

nodes.partnerMessage: Duelist and Initiator flex. I play the wind-dash girl when I need to entry, and the owl-drone archer when my squad needs actual site recon.

choices.choiceText: A flex player?! That is literally the holy grail of teammates.
Wind-dash girl? So you bait your team and dash into walls?

nodes.partnerMessage: Grass doesn't have 240Hz refresh rate or competitive ranked ladder rewards, sweetie. Go back to mowing your front yard.

choices.choiceText: You're going to get carpal tunnel before you're 22.
Fair point. What's your favorite off-meta pick when trolling?

nodes.partnerMessage: When they type '?' in chat after round two, and then you 13-3 them and drop 'gg close game'? That is sweeter than any dessert on earth.

choices.choiceText: The psychological warfare! You're vicious and I love it.
You sound like someone who holds grudges across multiple game seasons.

nodes.partnerMessage: Hit Radiant two acts ago in Valiant, currently sitting high Immortal while balancing university midterms. In Global Strike, Level 10 on the private competitive client.

choices.choiceText: Immortal while in college?! Your discipline must be insane.
Sounds like you have zero social life outside your monitor glow.
I'm hardstuck Gold, but I have god-tier comms and morale support.

nodes.partnerMessage: My headshot percentage is 38.4%, darling. You couldn't hit that if you were standing six inches from a practice dummy.

choices.choiceText: Stats don't matter when you choke under tournament pressure.
Damn, 38%? Okay, I'll shut up. That's actually cracked.

nodes.partnerMessage: Say that louder for the randoms in solo queue! If nobody throws the blind or drops the smoke, flashy aim is completely useless.

choices.choiceText: I'll be your designated utility support. You call the play, I flash.
Let's test this synergy. Where can we actually play together?

nodes.partnerMessage: I have Discord notifications set for when the balance developers breathe! If a rifle recoil spread changes by 0.05 degrees, I need to know!

choices.choiceText: That level of passion is wildly attractive to me.
That sounds like a mild psychiatric obsession, but go off.

nodes.partnerMessage: Crutch?! Try transferring spray across three enemies on B-site without missing a single round! You're talking out of your rank.

choices.choiceText: Let me see you do it then. Prove it in a match.

nodes.partnerMessage: Mmh. A confident sidearm user. I'll believe it when I see you clutch a 1v2 on eco round with a default pistol without screaming.

choices.choiceText: Put me on your squad. I'll show you how it's done.

nodes.partnerMessage: Hahaha! At least you admit it! There is nothing more hilarious than an enemy sniper jumping around like a panicked frog when caught off guard.

choices.choiceText: I make people laugh even when I'm dying in-game.

nodes.partnerMessage: Esports athletes train eight hours a day, have physical trainers, and play for millions. Keep your 1998 mindset to yourself, boomer.

choices.choiceText: You're still sitting on your ass in front of pixels.

nodes.partnerMessage: I will construct a three-tier Japanese pagoda with automated sorting systems, and you are going to farm wheat like a humble serf.

choices.choiceText: As long as the pagoda has a balcony for us to watch sunset, deal.
I'm stealing all your diamonds the second you log off.

nodes.partnerMessage: It IS an over-engineered redstone monstrosity! I automated my furnace room with flying slime machines! It took me 14 hours and I regret nothing!

choices.choiceText: Fourteen hours?! You're an absolute mad genius.

nodes.partnerMessage: Drill number one: Crosshair placement. If I catch your crosshair dragging along the carpet while walking through A-main, I'm throwing a flashbang right at your face.

choices.choiceText: Harsh, but fair. What's drill number two?

nodes.partnerMessage: You? Carry me? In your wildest fever dreams, sweetheart! I'll drop 30 bombs before you finish buying shields on round two.

choices.choiceText: Talk is cheap on a dating app. Let's see it in the server.

nodes.partnerMessage: 'From girls'? Oh, you're one of THOSE guys. The kind who gets fragile when a woman has better recoil control than him. Enjoy your ban.

choices.choiceText: Cry more about it.

nodes.partnerMessage: Enjoy your $10 sticky membrane keyboard while I type at 140 WPM with lubed linear switches and brass plates. Bye scrub.

choices.choiceText: Imagine being elitist over plastic keys.

nodes.partnerMessage: Wait, you actually know about custom keyboards?! 65% layout, hand-lubed linear switches, custom coiled cable. It thocks like heavy raindrops on a tin roof.

choices.choiceText: That deep thock sound is pure ASMR. You have elite taste.
I need to hear you type on that over voice comms.

nodes.partnerMessage: See? You can appreciate a good counter-attack when you see one. Maybe you have potential after all.

choices.choiceText: I'm full of potential. Test me in your private voice channel.

nodes.partnerMessage: Thank you, {PlayerName}. Truly. Do you know how tiring it is to carry four random men and still get told to go back to the kitchen? It gets old.

choices.choiceText: You never have to prove your worth to me, Daisy. I see your skill.
Let them stay mad while you collect rank trophies.

nodes.partnerMessage: All the time. If I'm top fragging, they get quiet and sullen. If I make one mistake, suddenly it's because 'girls can't aim.' That's why I keep my circle tiny.

choices.choiceText: Is there room in that circle for someone who genuinely respects you?
Sounds like you carry a lot of frustration from solo queue.

nodes.partnerMessage: I play what the team needs! But don't think I won't drop 25 kills with utility setups. I don't just set up plays, I finish them.

choices.choiceText: Brains, lethal aim, and selflessness. Where have you been hiding?

nodes.partnerMessage: I NEVER DASH INTO WALLS! Okay, maybe once on Bind when my mouse cable snagged on my water bottle, but we don't talk about that incident!

choices.choiceText: Hahaha! Bungee cord for your mouse is arriving tomorrow.

nodes.partnerMessage: I do wrist stretches every two hours, thank you very much. Go be miserable somewhere else.

choices.choiceText: Have fun getting replaced by an aimbot.

nodes.partnerMessage: Shotguns on eco rounds. Sitting inside one-way smoke clouds on site like a spider waiting for prey.

choices.choiceText: That is absolutely demonic. I love it.

nodes.partnerMessage: Psychological warfare is half the battle! If the enemy team starts arguing with each other in all-chat, the game is already won.

choices.choiceText: You're a tactical mastermind. Let's form our duo.

nodes.partnerMessage: If someone teabags me in round one, I memorize their gamer tag, their skins, and their IP address. They will not see the light of day for the rest of that half.

choices.choiceText: Remind me never to get on your bad side.
I'll be right beside you hunting them down.

nodes.partnerMessage: It takes discipline! Wake up at 7, lectures until 2, gym for an hour, study, and then team scrims from 7 to 10 PM. People think gamers are lazy, but my schedule is military.

choices.choiceText: That is wildly impressive. You have genuine work ethic.
When do you ever have time to date?

nodes.partnerMessage: I have a 3.8 GPA and a collegiate esports scholarship that pays my tuition. What's your excuse for being mediocre?

choices.choiceText: Scholarship for playing video games? What a joke.
Damn. That actually shut me up. You're incredible.

nodes.partnerMessage: Gold with good comms beats a silent Diamond with an ego every single time. I'd rather queue with someone who talks.

choices.choiceText: Then let me talk to you on private voice.

nodes.partnerMessage: I clutched a 1v3 in the collegiate finals while 10,000 people were watching on stream. The only person choking here is you on your own ego.

choices.choiceText: Whatever, nerd. Bye.

nodes.partnerMessage: Hahaha, humility looks good on you. Stick with me and I'll get your headshot percentage past 25%.

choices.choiceText: I'm sticking right beside you. Give me your OnlyYaps.

nodes.partnerMessage: ...You'd really play support for me? Most guys demand to be the star duelist while I'm forced to baby them with heals and flashes.

choices.choiceText: I don't need the glory. I just want to see you shine.

nodes.partnerMessage: This built-in chat app has so much latency it's giving me ghost inputs. I need low-latency comms.

choices.choiceText: Where do you run your voice server?

nodes.partnerMessage: Careful, {PlayerName}. If you gas me up like that, I might actually invite you to watch my collegiate semi-finals on private stream.

choices.choiceText: Front row seat with your banner in my hands. Send the stream link.

nodes.partnerMessage: Obsession is just what amateurs call dedication! But... okay, fine. Maybe I do check weapon tier lists while eating cereal.

choices.choiceText: Admitting it is the first step. Let's talk somewhere better.

nodes.partnerMessage: I'll think about it. But if you whiff a point-blank shotgun blast, you owe me two bubble teas.

choices.choiceText: Deal. Now give me your comms link.

nodes.partnerMessage: Gaming with you actually sounds fun instead of a high-stress sweat session. I forgot games could just be fun.

choices.choiceText: I'm here to bring the fun back. Come join me on OnlyYaps.

nodes.partnerMessage: A sunset balcony with someone who doesn't grief my storage chests... why is that genuinely the sweetest date pitch I've ever gotten?

choices.choiceText: Because I actually care about your peace. Let's make it real.

nodes.partnerMessage: If you touch my diamond chest, I will wire TNT under your spawn bed with tripwires. You have been warned!

choices.choiceText: A dangerous girl. Exactly my type.

nodes.partnerMessage: My friends called it a mental breakdown, but you call it genius. You're officially hired as my Chief Moral Officer.

choices.choiceText: When do I start my shift? Send the link.

nodes.partnerMessage: Drill number two: Comms discipline. No screaming 'HE IS ONE HP' when he still has full shields and heavy armor.

choices.choiceText: Accurate damage numbers only. I promise.

nodes.partnerMessage: I'm warming up my aim right now on AimLab. Meet me in my private OnlyYaps comms channel if you're brave enough.
You appreciate the thock?! Okay, marry me. Most guys just use whatever crusty keyboard came free with their prebuilt PC.

choices.choiceText: Only if we can have custom keycaps as wedding favors. Comms link?

nodes.partnerMessage: You want to hear it live? I'll unmute my studio microphone on OnlyYaps voice. Link below, cutie.
Stop it... my eyes are getting sweaty and gamers aren't allowed to cry over text messages. You're too good to be true.

choices.choiceText: I'm completely real, Daisy. Click the link and let's talk.

nodes.partnerMessage: Damn right! My shelf has three collegiate MVP trophies and there's plenty of room for more.

choices.choiceText: Let's win the next one together. Send me the server.

nodes.partnerMessage: I think... I think there's room for you. Just don't break my trust, {PlayerName}.

choices.choiceText: Never. Let's hop over to OnlyYaps.

nodes.partnerMessage: It wears your soul down. Playing five matches where everyone's screaming at each other... sometimes I close the game and just sit in the dark.

choices.choiceText: You don't have to sit in the dark alone anymore. Talk to me.

nodes.partnerMessage: In my custom room waiting for a player who doesn't tilt after losing pistol round! Click my link, handsome.
A mouse bungee?! If someone gifts me gaming hardware, I am legally obligated to fall in love with them. Link below!
Demonic and proud! Come check out my highlight reels on OnlyYaps.
Stay on my good side and you get complimentary callouts and headshot protection. Link below!
Bonnie and Clyde with sniper rifles. That's our energy. Hop into my server right now.
Thank you... most people just think it's easy. Hearing you recognize the grind means everything. Let's move to OnlyYaps.
I make time for people who are worth it. And so far, {PlayerName}... you're making the leaderboard. Comms link below!
Hahaha! Good. I like someone who can admit when they got outplayed. Meet me on OnlyYaps.
That might be the sweetest sentence anyone has ever typed to me. My heart rate is spiking and we haven't even spawned yet. Join my server below.
VIP access granted. I'll dedicate my first ace clutch to you. Hit my private channel below!
Toxic, bad at the game, and zero charm. Unmatched, reported, and blocked from the server. Enjoy solo queue forever.
Click this server invite link. Join my private OnlyYaps voice channel so we can duo without this app lagging out.
